item.title: Gov. Abbott announces new NRG power plant to be located near Houston's Greens Bayou
item.description: The new 455-megawatt natural gas facility has a capital investment of $617 million and is expected to begin generating power in 2028.

item.title: Ramadan 2026: What is it and when does it start?
item.description: Ramadan, the holiest month in Islam, begins at sunset on Feb. 17. The month of fasting, prayer and reflection follows the lunar calendar and ends with the celebration of Eid al-Fitr. Here’s what to know about when it starts and why Muslims observe it.
